workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI terminal prompt-loop IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority has pure command, settings, validation, proof, interactive-selection, and materialized-entrypoint contracts, but it has no public import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room prompt-loop contract for no-argument vihs prompt transcript/state behavior.

splitDecision.reason: Prompt-loop behavior is the next discoverability unit after materialized-entrypoint closeout, but it should be admitted as a pure prompt transcript/state contract before OS terminal I/O drivers, compare execution, runtime execution, live-session proof, packaging, or Marketplace behavior.
doNotAdmitTogether: OS-specific raw stdin/TTY process drivers or spawned terminal I/O handling
proof-out file writing beyond already admitted proof artifact contracts
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof

allowed: prerequisite references to the already admitted and implemented runtime-settings-cli-terminal-entrypoint-v1 materialized-entrypoint work
supporting public test expectations TEST-UNIT-353 and TEST-UNIT-354
package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0
public selection fields for provider, platform, LabVIEW version, and LabVIEW bitness
deterministic prompt transcript/state behavior for no-argument vihs
Enter-through confirmation that preserves the current governed selection
guided host selection for supported LabVIEW 2025, LabVIEW 2026, and newer local host choices when the selected installation and bitness are present
validation handoff after confirmation through the already public vihs --validate readback contract

stable fail-closed reasons for unsupported years, host/platform mismatch, missing selected bitness, unsupported Docker bitness, unsupported Docker year, unsupported Linux host paths, and not-yet-implemented paths
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
private proof packets or private issue templates
OS-specific raw stdin/TTY process-driver implementation details
proof-out file writing beyond already admitted proof artifact contracts
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation

candidateImplementationWork: add tests proving no-argument vihs produces a deterministic prompt transcript from the already materialized entrypoint facts
add tests proving Enter-through confirmation preserves the current governed provider/platform/version/bitness bundle and requests validation handoff
add tests proving guided host selection accepts supported local host choices and fails closed for unsupported years, host/platform mismatches, or missing selected bitness
add tests proving Docker selection remains bounded to 2026 / x64
implement the minimum public MIT terminal prompt-loop contract as pure prompt state and output facts, without OS terminal I/O drivers or runtime execution

candidateTasks: add tests for deterministic no-argument vihs prompt transcript/state behavior
add tests for Enter-through confirmation and validation handoff
add tests for guided host selection and fail-closed unsupported host paths
add tests for bounded Docker 2026 / x64 selection
implement the pure terminal prompt-loop contract
blockedTasks: OS-specific raw stdin/TTY process drivers or spawned terminal I/O handling
proof-out file writing beyond already admitted proof artifact contracts
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
source copying from GitLab or GitHub Suite

allowedNextWork: create the public MIT import packet for runtime-settings-cli-terminal-prompt-loop-v1
create the public Spec Kit feature spec, plan, and tasks
add public admission records with implementationStartAllowed false until preflight passes
run public redaction and artifact validation
notAllowedNextWork: implementing terminal prompt-loop behavior before public preflight
adding OS-specific raw stdin/TTY process drivers in the prompt-loop IAU
copying runtime settings implementation source from another VI History authority
adding VSIX packaging or Marketplace publishing
